title: Template kit holds Publish on a kit the Website opportunity flow cannot use, and the install file on a part GitHub states another sha256 for
steps: S1: From the checkout run: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/template-kit-flow-reads.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/road-to-live.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: Each flow gap code (kit-logo-unsettable, kit-brand-colour-from-link, kit-navigation-missing, kit-map-mismatch, kit-front-page-group, kit-brand-unreadable, kit-zip-missing) is todo on an otherwise approved kit; kit-setting-slot-missing only warns.
A seed shaped T3 kit gives kit-logo-unsettable, kit-brand-colour-from-link and kit-navigation-missing.
The JA Boxing 1.0.10 kit committed in the repo has no flow gap and stays kit-approved.
An install part whose sha256 GitHub states otherwise is todo install-file-sha-mismatch and the publish door refuses NOT_A_CARD naming the file.

selectors.function: apps/tracy-web/src/lib/template-kit/flow-reads.js flowGapsOf, kitMapOf; apps/tracy-web/src/lib/template-kit/road-step.js templateKitStep; apps/tracy-web/src/lib/road-to-live.js roadOf, publishRefusalOf

evidence: A T3 seed kit passed Template kit while its header logo spot had no setting or frame, its accent was the link colour and a menu block had no navigation group: the brand step, the planner and the writer could not use it.
fence: templateKitStep runs flowGapsOf after the version check: a todo flow gap holds Publish before the approval, and every gap rides along as flowGaps; roadOf compares install part sha256 with the asset digest GitHub states.

tests: kit-logo-unsettable: a shown logo spot with no setting and a frame the content map lacks
kit-brand-colour-from-link: an accent that paints links only, with the stylesheet primary named
kit-navigation-missing: a menu block of the content map with no navigation group
kit-map-mismatch: kit slots the content map beside it does not hold (a kit of another map)
kit-front-page-group: the front page inside another group, or not its representative
kit-brand-unreadable: the very check the brand bench refuses a run on
kit-zip-missing: the release lacks the kit image zip; a local pack is not asked
kit-setting-slot-missing only warns: a map button or a frame painted behind with no setting slot
a seed shaped T3 kit: logo with no setting, accent from links, a menu with no group
the JA Boxing 1.0.10 kit committed in this repo has no flow gap and stays approved
an install part whose sha256 GitHub states otherwise holds Publish: the host would refuse the download
